item.title: Automating a one-person back office: what to automate first
item.dc:creator: Raki
item.description: Ravolution is one person. The order I automated the back office in, the rule I used to choose what came first, and the jobs I have deliberately kept manual.

item.title: How an AI receptionist actually takes an order — and when it hands over to a human
item.dc:creator: Raki
item.description: What actually happens between the ring and the order text: the divert, the menu as guardrail, the read-back, and the five moments the AI hands over to a person.

item.title: The Friday-night phone problem: what a missed call really costs a takeaway
item.dc:creator: Raki
item.description: Most takeaway owners know they miss calls on a Friday. Here is a plain way to put a number on it, with every assumption shown so you can use your own.
